0022600145.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-4) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (0-4) in a meeting of two winless teams, with the Kings on a four-game losing streak and sitting 15th in the West. The Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while the Pelicans are without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle), and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Kings lost the season series 1-2, though Sacramento won the most recent meeting 117-113 in Sacramento on April 3, 2026.
